rationale: C08 is a highly plausible direct drafting source: it concerns McKay’s same decision to leave the Cabinet and campaign in Oregon only weeks earlier, and the child reuses its particular account of his private and public experience, Interior service, value to the Administration, and anticipated benefit to Oregon and the nation. C25 provides additional close language about Interior’s conservation and development responsibilities, while C24 parallels the resignation of a Cabinet secretary seeking a Senate seat, but neither is as directly tied to the child’s recipient and circumstances as C08.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I understand your purpose and I salute your determination to bring the facts pertaining to this Administration before your fellow citizens of Oregon.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your decision to campaign for election to the United States Senate from your beloved State of Oregon is worthy of the highest commendation.
shared_material.explanation: Both commend McKay’s departure specifically to campaign in Oregon.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As a Cabinet member you have helped shape our programs... Your counsel in these matters has been of inestimable value.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: You have been a tremendous asset to us in the Cabinet and you will be missed.
shared_material.explanation: The child expands C08’s assessment of McKay’s value as a Cabinet member.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your knowledge of natural resource conservation and management, gained through long years of experience in private life and as a public official, has served the nation well... I have no doubt that it will continue to be of benefit to your State and the nation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The vast experience you have gained in private life, as a veteran State Legislator, Governor, and able administrator of the vital affairs of the Department of the Interior... [is important] not only to the people of Oregon but to the remainder of the nation as well.
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive parallel formulation linking McKay’s private and public experience to service benefiting both Oregon and the nation.
